payload.title: Bound git-native fold cost at scale
payload.body: readEvents runs a git subprocess per commit so fold is O(n) with heavy constant overhead, and tasks pick folds 2-3 times per call. Cache the fold per tasks-claims commit and/or batch the git reads, then add a perf conformance check asserting fold + render stay under budget at 10k+ events. Pairs with auto-compaction.
